name: F.H.E.D — Fons for Health, Education and Development
renamed: 2021, as Fons for Health, Education and Development
description: An association of Meta Fons headquartered in the Guneku Palace. It was founded in 2003 as Fons Against AIDS, with HRH Fon Fomuki Patrick Nji of Guneku as its founding president, and was renamed in 2021 because the original name covered only HIV and AIDS. Its mandate now runs to pandemics, the education and vocational training of children and people in need, poverty and hunger, community sensitisation, care and support, the development of community libraries and training, income-generating activity, social cohesion, and support to displaced people and returnees.

executive.holder: HRH Dr. Fomuki W. Ticha, Fon of Guneku
HRH Prof. W. Mbacham of Funam-Bome

recordedActivity.activity: Eight benches, valued at 200,000 FCFA, donated to the Presbyterian School Annex at Ku.

In the courtyard of the Guneku Palace, a donation to 28 persons living with disabilities from Guneku and neighbouring villages: 220 table birds, 22 bags of feed, four wheelchairs and anti-epilepsy medication. Total value 1,381,000 FCFA.
